sources.excerpt: Keeley Electronics Octa Psi Transfigurating Fuzz - Pedal of the Day Reviews Demos Buy a Pedalboard Interviews Contact Navigation Menu Menu Keeley Electronics Octa Psi Transfigurating Fuzz Posted By Pedal of the Day on Tuesday, September 24, 2024 in Fuzz, Keeley Electronics, Octave, Pitch Shifters | 0 comments --> --> What a day! After this morning’s release of the new UAFX Enigmatic ’82 Overdrive Special Amp from Universal Audio , this afternoon brings us a release from another one of our favorite companies: Keeley Electronics . Going off the beaten sonic path in a BIG way, they’ve released the Octa Psi Transfigurating Fuzz, which mixes distortion, fuzz, octave and pitch shifting together in some of the most unique ways we’ve ever seen. Not for the boring or faint of heart, this black beauty brings power, gusto, wackiness and glorious exploration right to the forefront… Imagine merging a powerful pitch-shifter , octave generator , and analog fuzz into one intuitive pedal. With the new Octa Psi, Keeley has made that dream a reality! The all-analog, transistor-based fuzz circuit delivers incredible sound with wave after wave of gain staging leading to hard clipping, carving out the perfect fuzz tone with Scoop, Punch, or Psi mode, and making your guitar pickups sound enormous at any volume. The Pitch/Octave side features Up, Down, and Dual modes for creating nearly every harmonic interval, including power chords, stacked fourths, and diminished chords. Momentary Mode is perfect for dive-bombs and wild multi-octave bends, and the adjustable Ramp Speed option creates perfectly timed pitch bending, just like having an onboard expression pedal. You can easily switch between Octave/Pitch before or after fuzz by holding down both foot switches, or switch between All Wet or Wet/Dry blend with a quick double-tap of the Blend control. +/- Two Octave Range and nearly every harmonic interval Low latency and fast tracking for great tone in dropped tunings or wild bends Switchable All-Wet ⇆ Wet/Dry Blend by double tapping the Blend control Momentary or Latching Octave and Pitch Shifter by holding down the Fuzz stomp Adjustable Ramp Speed for the pitch shifter by holding Octave down and adjusting Blend Three pitch-shifting modes (Up/Dual/Down) for multiple octaves, crazy intervals, chords, and even chorus modulation Super thick, analog transistor fuzz and distortion Three-way bass response: Scoop, Punch, or Psi mode for massive undertones Order switching between Fuzz ⇆ Octave (Pitch) by pressing and holding both Octave and Fuzz The Octa Psi Transfigurating Fuzz is FUN – there’s no doubt about it. While it can get you wonderful, warm, fuzzy octave tones with ease, the real magic here is when you get to experimenting, twisting and turning knobs and flipping switches and just having a good time making noise. Be sure to head over to the Keeley Electronics website for more info, and don’t forget to check out our fresh new demo video over on YouTube – cheers!!
